`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	学完本讲，你应该能够：
6

9	3. 说出 ADAMW + poly 学习率调度在 Mask2Former 各配置中的组合方式，并能动手画出学习率曲线。
10	
11	本讲只聚焦 `train_net.py` 中两个被 detectron2 引擎回调的类方法：`build_optimizer` 与 `build_lr_scheduler`。它们是 [train_net.py:175-262](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L175-L262) 中连续的两段代码，前者决定「每个参数怎么更新」，后者决定「学习率随时间怎么变」。
12	
13	## 2. 前置知识
14	
15	### 2.1 参数组（param group）：一个优化器，多种超参
16	
17	PyTorch 的优化器（如 `torch.optim.AdamW`）允许把参数拆成多个「组」，每组携带自己的 `lr`、`weight_decay` 等超参。构造时传入的是一个字典列表：
18	
19	```python
20	optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW([
21	    {"params": backbone_params, "lr": 1e-5, "weight_decay": 0.05},
22	    {"params": head_params,     "lr": 1e-4, "weight_decay": 0.05},
23	])
24	```
25	
26	为什么需要分组？因为不同模块的「训练阶段」不同：backbone 用 ImageNet 预训练权重初始化，已经很好，只想被轻微微调；而解码器是随机初始化的，需要更大的步长。Mask2Former 的 `build_optimizer` 本质上就是一个「参数组工厂」，把模型的每个参数塞进一个（通常只含单个参数的）组里。
27	
28	### 2.2 AdamW 与解耦 weight decay
29	
30	AdamW 是 Adam 的变体，把 weight decay 从梯度更新中「解耦」出来：衰减项不经过自适应学习率缩放，直接按 \( \theta \leftarrow \theta - \eta \, \lambda \theta \) 施加。Transformer 类模型普遍搭配 AdamW + 较小 decay（Mask2Former 取 0.05），这是从 DETR / ViT 一脉相承的惯例。GETTING_STARTED 里还特别提醒：由于用 ADAMW，「如何按 batch size 缩放学习率并不明确」，单卡训练需要自己调 `SOLVER.BASE_LR`（见 [GETTING_STARTED.md:45-52](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/GETTING_STARTED.md#L45-L52)，这段话解释了为什么仓库只给出 8 卡配置）。
31	
32	### 2.3 梯度裁剪：为什么 Transformer 训练离不开它
33	
34	深层注意力网络的反向传播容易出现个别维度上的超大梯度，一步就把参数推飞（loss 突然变成 NaN）。梯度裁剪在每次 `optimizer.step()` 之前检查全模型梯度的 L2 范数 \( \|g\|_2 \)，若超过阈值 \( \tau \) 就整体缩放：
35	
36	\[
37	g \leftarrow g \cdot \frac{\tau}{\max(\tau, \; \|g\|_2)}
38	\]
39	
40	「全模型」三个字是关键：PyTorch 自带的 `torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_` 天然支持把所有参数拼在一起算范数，但 detectron2 内置的裁剪是**逐参数**的——这正是 Mask2Former 要自己写一个包装类的动机（见 4.2）。
41	
42	### 2.4 学习率调度：warmup 与 poly
43	
44	- **warmup（预热）**：训练最初若干 iteration 用很小的学习率线性升温，避免随机初始化的模块在第一步就被大梯度破坏。
45	- **poly 调度**：DeepLab 系的经典做法，学习率随迭代数按幂函数衰减到 0：
46	
47	\[
48	\text{lr}(t) = \text{lr}_0 \cdot \left(1 - \frac{t}{T}\right)^{\gamma}, \quad \gamma \approx 0.9
49	\]
50	
51	其中 \( T \) 是总迭代数 `SOLVER.MAX_ITER`。相比 multi-step（阶梯式）衰减，poly 曲线平滑，分割任务上经验效果更好。
52

54

69	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
70	
71	### 4.1 build_optimizer：按模块名分组的参数组工厂
72	
73	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
74	
75	`build_optimizer` 解决的问题是：**给模型里每一类参数挑合适的 lr 和 weight decay**。它一次遍历模型的所有参数，根据「参数所在模块的名字」和「参数所在模块的类型」套用四条规则，最终产出一个参数组列表交给 AdamW。
76	
77	四条规则（按源码顺序，后命中者覆盖先命中者）：
78	
79	| 规则 | 判断依据 | 效果 | 动机 |
80	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
81	| ① backbone 降 lr | 模块路径名包含 `"backbone"` | `lr *= BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER`（默认 0.1） | backbone 有 ImageNet 预训练，只需轻微微调 |
82	| ② 位置参数免衰减 | 参数名含 `relative_position_bias_table` 或 `absolute_pos_embed` | `weight_decay = 0` | 位置偏置是「坐标查表」性质的参数，衰减它等于系统性削弱位置信息（Swin 论文惯例） |
83	| ③ norm 层特殊衰减 | 模块是 `nn.LayerNorm` / `nn.GroupNorm` / 各种 BN / InstanceNorm | `weight_decay = WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM` | norm 层的仿射参数量少、作用关键，通常单独设 0 |
84	| ④ Embedding 特殊衰减 | 模块是 `nn.Embedding` | `weight_decay = WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED`（默认 0） | query/level 嵌入表与位置编码同理，不衰减 |
85	
86	还有两个前置过滤：`requires_grad=False` 的参数直接跳过（冻结参数不进优化器）；用 `memo` 集合去重，避免同一个参数（如共享权重）因出现在多个模块路径下被重复加入。
87	
88	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
89	
90	```text
91	build_optimizer(cfg, model):
92	    defaults = {lr: BASE_LR, weight_decay: WEIGHT_DECAY}
93	    params, memo = [], set()
94	    for (module_name, module) in model.named_modules():        # 逐模块
95	        for (param_name, value) in module.named_parameters(recurse=False):  # 只看直属参数
96	            if not value.requires_grad:  continue              # 过滤冻结参数
97	            if value in memo:           continue               # 去重（共享参数）
98	            memo.add(value)
99	            h = copy(defaults)
100	            if "backbone" in module_name:                      # 规则①
101	                h.lr = h.lr * BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER
102	            if "relative_position_bias_table" in param_name \
103	               or "absolute_pos_embed" in param_name:          # 规则②
104	                h.weight_decay = 0.0
105	            if isinstance(module, NORM_TYPES): h.weight_decay = WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM   # 规则③
106	            if isinstance(module, nn.Embedding): h.weight_decay = WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED # 规则④
107	            params.append({"params": [value], **h})            # 每个参数一组
108	    optimizer = (带裁剪包装的 AdamW)(params, BASE_LR)
109	    return optimizer
110	```
111	
112	注意三个细节：
113	
114	1. **遍历的是模块，判断的是两种名字**：`module_name` 是模块路径（如 `backbone.res2`、`sem_seg_head.pixel_decoder...`），规则①按它做子串匹配；`module_param_name` 是参数在模块内的属性名（如 `weight`、`relative_position_bias_table`），规则②按它匹配。
115	2. **规则可叠加**：一个参数可以同时命中①和③——比如 Swin backbone 里某个 LayerNorm 的 weight，lr 会被乘 0.1，weight_decay 会被换成 `WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM`。规则②在规则③之前执行，所以如果某个位置参数恰好长在 norm 模块上，norm 的衰减会覆盖「免衰减」——实际不会发生，因为 `relative_position_bias_table` 是 `nn.Parameter` 直接挂在 block 上（见 4.1.3）。
116	3. **每组只有一个参数**：`{"params": [value], ...}`，因此一个 4700 万参数的 R50 模型会产生数千个 param group。对 AdamW 来说每组独立维护状态，功能等价，只是构建开销略大。
117	
118	#### 4.1.3 源码精读
119

121

133	**规则②命中的参数长什么样？** 它们只在 Swin backbone 里存在：`relative_position_bias_table` 是每个 SwinTransformerBlock 上的一个直接 `nn.Parameter`（[swin.py:105-108](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/modeling/backbone/swin.py#L105-L108)，形状 `(2W_h-1)(2W_w-1) × nH`，是窗口注意力的相对位置偏置查表）；`absolute_pos_embed` 只在 `APE=True` 时存在（[swin.py:575-578](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/modeling/backbone/swin.py#L575-L578)，而默认 `APE: False`，见 [config.py:87](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/config.py#L87) 与 [swin_tiny_bs16_50ep.yaml:10](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/swin/maskformer2_swin_tiny_bs16_50ep.yaml#L10)）。因为它是 `nn.Parameter` 属性而非子模块，规则④的 `isinstance(module, nn.Embedding)` 抓不到它，必须靠规则②的**名字匹配**——这就是两条规则并存的原因。
134	
135	**规则④命中的参数**：Transformer 解码器里的三个嵌入表——`query_feat`（可学习 query 特征）、`query_embed`（可学习 query 位置编码）、`level_embed`（尺度嵌入），见 [mask2former_transformer_decoder.py:314-322](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/modeling/transformer_decoder/mask2former_transformer_decoder.py#L314-L322)。它们的衰减系数是 `SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED`，由 [config.py:22-27](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/config.py#L22-L27) 注册，默认 `0.0`——与位置参数免衰减的动机一致：这些都是「坐标/身份查表」，不该被衰减拉向 0。
136	
137	**配置侧的实际取值**（[Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml:19-35](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L19-L35)）：`BASE_LR: 0.0001`、`WEIGHT_DECAY: 0.05`、`OPTIMIZER: "ADAMW"`、`BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER: 0.1`。对照 [config.py:24-27](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/config.py#L24-L27)（`add_maskformer2_config` 的 solver 段）可以看到：yaml 里的这三项与注册默认值相同，写出来是为了显式声明。`WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM` 不是 Mask2Former 注册的键，而是 detectron2 `get_cfg()` 自带的默认键，仓库所有 yaml 都没有覆盖它，实际取值以本地安装的 detectron2 默认为准（实践里打印确认；detectron2 默认为 0.0，待本地验证）。

139	**一个容易忽略的事实**：R50 配置下规则②**一次都不会命中**——ResNet 没有这两个参数。所以「Swin 位置参数免衰减」这条规则的效果只能在 Swin 配置（如 [swin/maskformer2_swin_tiny_bs16_50ep.yaml](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/swin/maskformer2_swin_tiny_bs16_50ep.yaml#L1-L15)，它继承 R50 配置只换 backbone）上观察到。

287	### 4.2 maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping：动态子类化实现全局梯度裁剪
288	
289	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
290	
291	梯度裁剪有两种粒度：
292	
293	- **逐参数裁剪**（detectron2 原生 `maybe_add_gradient_clipping` 支持）：每个参数单独算范数单独缩放。优点是可与 per-parameter clip value 精细配合，缺点是「整体方向感」差——一个参数的超大梯度不会牵动其他参数一起缩。
294	- **全模型裁剪**（full model clipping）：把所有参数的梯度拼在一起算一个全局 L2 范数，超过阈值整体缩放。DETR 系 Transformer 训练的标准做法是这一种。
295	
296	[train_net.py:233](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L232-L233) 的注释直说了动机："detectron2 doesn't have full model gradient clipping now"。所以 Mask2Former 自己实现了一个，并且实现方式很巧：**不改训练循环，而是动态生成一个优化器子类，重写 `step()`**。
297	
298	另一个背景是 AMP：Base 配置都开了混合精度（`AMP.ENABLED: True`，[Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml:34-35](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L34-L35)），fp16 数值范围小，梯度更容易溢出，全局裁剪 + 梯度缩放是标配组合。
299	
300	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
301	
302	```text
303	maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping(optim_class):
304	    if CLIP_GRADIENTS.ENABLED
305	       and CLIP_TYPE == "full_model"
306	       and CLIP_VALUE > 0:
307	        class FullModelGradientClippingOptimizer(optim_class):   # 动态子类化
308	            def step(closure=None):
309	                all_params = chain(所有 param_groups 的所有参数)
310	                clip_grad_norm_(all_params, CLIP_VALUE)   # 先全局裁剪
311	                super().step(closure)                     # 再正常更新
312	        return FullModelGradientClippingOptimizer
313	    else:
314	        return optim_class    # 原样返回，不加包装
315	```
316	
317	调用侧的写法是 `maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping(torch.optim.AdamW)(params, BASE_LR)`——传入的是**类**（不是实例），返回的也是类，随后立刻实例化。这是一个「类装饰器」。
318	
319	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
320	
321	**包装函数本体**（[train_net.py:232-247](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L232-L247)）：
322	
323	- L234-239：三个条件同时满足才启用——`CLIP_GRADIENTS.ENABLED`、`CLIP_TYPE == "full_model"`、`CLIP_VALUE > 0.0`。任何一个不满足就原样返回优化器类。
324	- L241-245：在函数体内 `class FullModelGradientClippingOptimizer(optim)` 定义子类——Python 允许在函数里定义类，且基类可以是运行时传入的变量，于是同一个包装函数对 SGD 和 AdamW 都适用。`step()` 先用 `itertools.chain` 把所有 param group 的参数扁平化（这正是 4.1 里「每组一个参数」的结构在这里的代价与便利：chain 拼接即可），交给 `torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_` 做全局 L2 裁剪，再调用 `super().step()` 执行真正的 AdamW 更新。
325	- L247：启用则返回子类，否则返回原类。
326	
327	**调用点与优化器分发**（[train_net.py:249-262](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L249-L262)）：
328	
329	- L250-253：`OPTIMIZER == "SGD"` 分支（带 momentum），仓库配置不用它，但保留了对 detectron2 旧项目的兼容。
330	- L254-257：`OPTIMIZER == "ADAMW"` 分支——所有 Base yaml 都写 `OPTIMIZER: "ADAMW"`，这是实际走的路径：`maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping(torch.optim.AdamW)(params, cfg.SOLVER.BASE_LR)`。

391	### 4.3 build_lr_scheduler 与 poly 学习率调度
392	
393	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
394	
395	`build_lr_scheduler` 决定学习率如何随 iteration 变化。Mask2Former 没有自己写调度器，而是直接复用 detectron2 **DeepLab 工程**的构建函数（[train_net.py:45](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L45) 导入的 `detectron2.projects.deeplab.build_lr_scheduler`），原因是它提供了 `WarmupPolyLR`——把 warmup 与 poly 衰减拼接的调度器：
396	
397	\[
398	\text{lr}(t) = \text{lr}_0 \cdot \underbrace{\min\left(1,\; \frac{t}{T_w} \cdot \frac{1}{f_w}\right)}_{\text{warmup 因子（前 } T_w \text{ 步）}} \cdot \underbrace{\left(1 - \frac{t}{T}\right)^{\gamma}}_{\text{poly 因子}}, \qquad \gamma \approx 0.9
399	\]
400	
401	其中 \( T_w \) 是 `SOLVER.WARMUP_ITERS`、\( f_w \) 与 `SOLVER.WARMUP_FACTOR` 相关、\( T \) 是 `SOLVER.MAX_ITER`。公式给出的是 poly 调度的标准形态；detectron2 deeplab 工程里的具体实现（含幂指数默认值、warmup 拼接细节）位于 `detectron2/projects/deeplab/build_solver.py`，属外部依赖，行号与精确默认值待本地确认（本仓库 yaml 未覆盖幂指数键）。
402	
403	仓库内两类 Base 配置给出了两种组合方式：
404	
405	| 配置族 | 调度器 | 关键键 | 行为 |
406	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
407	| ADE20K / Cityscapes / Mapillary 系 | 显式 `LR_SCHEDULER_NAME: "WarmupPolyLR"`（如 [Base-ADE20K...yaml:27](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/ade20k/panoptic-segmentation/Base-ADE20K-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L19-L35)） | `MAX_ITER: 160000`、`WARMUP_ITERS: 0`、无 `STEPS` | 纯 poly：从 1e-4 平滑衰减到 0 |
408	| COCO 系 | yaml 未写调度器名 | `STEPS: (327778, 355092)`、`MAX_ITER: 368750`、`WARMUP_ITERS: 10`、`WARMUP_FACTOR: 1.0`（[Base-COCO...yaml:19-35](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L19-L35)） | 调度器名取 detectron2 默认键（实践第 1 步打印确认），`STEPS` 表明按 multi-step 阶梯衰减设计 |
409	
410	注意 COCO 的 `WARMUP_FACTOR: 1.0` + `WARMUP_ITERS: 10` 实际上让 warmup 近似形同虚设（初始因子就是 1）。
411	
412	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
413	
414	```text
415	Trainer.build_lr_scheduler(cfg, optimizer):
416	    return detectron2.projects.deeplab.build_lr_scheduler(cfg, optimizer)
417	        ├─ 若 SOLVER.LR_SCHEDULER_NAME == "WarmupPolyLR":
418	        │      构造 warmup + poly 衰减调度器（实现于 deeplab 工程）
419	        └─ 否则: 回退 detectron2 原生 build_lr_scheduler
420	                 （支持 WarmupMultiStepLR 等，由 STEPS/MAX_ITER 驱动）
421	```
422	
423	调度器与优化器的关系：调度器并不「拥有」学习率，它在每个 iteration 末尾（`scheduler.step()`）改写优化器各 param_group 的 `lr` 字段。与 4.1 联动后，backbone 组的 lr 恒为其它组的 0.1 倍——poly 因子对所有组同乘。

530	## 6. 本讲小结
531	
532	- `build_optimizer` 是一个「参数组工厂」：双层遍历所有模块的直属参数，按四条规则（backbone lr × 0.1、Swin 位置参数 wd=0、norm 层用 `WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM`、Embedding 用 `WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED`）为**每个参数单独**生成一组超参，再交给 AdamW（[train_net.py:183-230](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L183-L230)）。
533	- 规则②只在 Swin backbone 上命中：`relative_position_bias_table` 是裸 `nn.Parameter`，只能靠参数名匹配（[swin.py:105-108](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/modeling/backbone/swin.py#L105-L108)）；R50 配置下该规则从不触发，源码里那行裸 `print`（L224）就是它的「显形」时刻。
534	- 全模型梯度裁剪通过「函数内动态定义优化器子类、重写 `step()`」实现，先对链式拼接的全部参数做 `clip_grad_norm_` 再更新，不侵入 detectron2 训练循环（[train_net.py:232-247](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L232-L247)）；仓库所有 Base 配置都用 `full_model` + `CLIP_VALUE=0.01`，detectron2 原生逐参数裁剪只是兼容回退分支。
535	- `build_lr_scheduler` 直接复用 detectron2 deeplab 工程的构建函数以获得 `WarmupPolyLR`（warmup + \( (1-t/T)^{0.9} \) 衰减）；ADE20K/Cityscapes/Mapillary 系显式启用 poly，COCO 系则配 `STEPS` 阶梯衰减（实际调度器名需打印合并后配置确认）。
536	- 学习率策略总结成一句话：**ADAMW（BASE_LR=1e-4，backbone ×0.1）+ 按任务选择的 poly/step 衰减 + 全模型 L2 梯度裁剪 0.01 + AMP**，这一整套来自分割与检测两条社区经验线的组合。
537	
538	## 7. 下一步学习建议
539	
540	- 下一讲（u3-l1）进入模型本体：`MaskFormer.forward` 的训练/推理两条路径。你会看到本讲的 `weight_dict` 与损失 dict 如何在 meta arch 里汇合。
541	- 建议顺手阅读两个外部文件（在本地 detectron2 安装目录）：`detectron2/solver/build.py`（原生 `build_optimizer` 与 `maybe_add_gradient_clipping`，对比 Mask2Former 版改了什么）和 `detectron2/projects/deeplab/build_solver.py`（`WarmupPolyLR` 的真实实现），把本讲标注「待确认」的细节补全。

# 优化器构建与学习率策略（u2-l4）

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 读懂 `Trainer.build_optimizer` 中「按模块名给参数分组」的完整规则表，并能解释为什么 backbone 用更小的学习率、Swin 位置参数不做 weight decay、norm 层和 Embedding 层各用各的衰减系数。
2. 理解 `maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping` 用「动态生成优化器子类」实现全模型梯度裁剪的技巧，以及它和 detectron2 原生裁剪的分工。
3. 说出 ADAMW + poly 学习率调度在 Mask2Former 各配置中的组合方式，并能动手画出学习率曲线。

本讲只聚焦 `train_net.py` 中两个被 detectron2 引擎回调的类方法：`build_optimizer` 与 `build_lr_scheduler`。它们是 [train_net.py:175-262](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L175-L262) 中连续的两段代码，前者决定「每个参数怎么更新」，后者决定「学习率随时间怎么变」。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 参数组（param group）：一个优化器，多种超参

PyTorch 的优化器（如 `torch.optim.AdamW`）允许把参数拆成多个「组」，每组携带自己的 `lr`、`weight_decay` 等超参。构造时传入的是一个字典列表：

```python
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW([
    {"params": backbone_params, "lr": 1e-5, "weight_decay": 0.05},
    {"params": head_params,     "lr": 1e-4, "weight_decay": 0.05},
])
```

为什么需要分组？因为不同模块的「训练阶段」不同：backbone 用 ImageNet 预训练权重初始化，已经很好，只想被轻微微调；而解码器是随机初始化的，需要更大的步长。Mask2Former 的 `build_optimizer` 本质上就是一个「参数组工厂」，把模型的每个参数塞进一个（通常只含单个参数的）组里。

### 2.2 AdamW 与解耦 weight decay

AdamW 是 Adam 的变体，把 weight decay 从梯度更新中「解耦」出来：衰减项不经过自适应学习率缩放，直接按 \( \theta \leftarrow \theta - \eta \, \lambda \theta \) 施加。Transformer 类模型普遍搭配 AdamW + 较小 decay（Mask2Former 取 0.05），这是从 DETR / ViT 一脉相承的惯例。GETTING_STARTED 里还特别提醒：由于用 ADAMW，「如何按 batch size 缩放学习率并不明确」，单卡训练需要自己调 `SOLVER.BASE_LR`（见 [GETTING_STARTED.md:45-52](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/GETTING_STARTED.md#L45-L52)，这段话解释了为什么仓库只给出 8 卡配置）。

### 2.3 梯度裁剪：为什么 Transformer 训练离不开它

深层注意力网络的反向传播容易出现个别维度上的超大梯度，一步就把参数推飞（loss 突然变成 NaN）。梯度裁剪在每次 `optimizer.step()` 之前检查全模型梯度的 L2 范数 \( \|g\|_2 \)，若超过阈值 \( \tau \) 就整体缩放：

\[
g \leftarrow g \cdot \frac{\tau}{\max(\tau, \; \|g\|_2)}
\]

「全模型」三个字是关键：PyTorch 自带的 `torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_` 天然支持把所有参数拼在一起算范数，但 detectron2 内置的裁剪是**逐参数**的——这正是 Mask2Former 要自己写一个包装类的动机（见 4.2）。

### 2.4 学习率调度：warmup 与 poly

- **warmup（预热）**：训练最初若干 iteration 用很小的学习率线性升温，避免随机初始化的模块在第一步就被大梯度破坏。
- **poly 调度**：DeepLab 系的经典做法，学习率随迭代数按幂函数衰减到 0：

\[
\text{lr}(t) = \text{lr}_0 \cdot \left(1 - \frac{t}{T}\right)^{\gamma}, \quad \gamma \approx 0.9
\]

其中 \( T \) 是总迭代数 `SOLVER.MAX_ITER`。相比 multi-step（阶梯式）衰减，poly 曲线平滑，分割任务上经验效果更好。

### 2.5 与前几讲的衔接

u2-l1 已经讲过：`Trainer` 继承 detectron2 的 `DefaultTrainer`，只覆写 `build_train_loader`、`build_optimizer`、`build_lr_scheduler`、`build_evaluator` 四个类方法，它们由引擎在构造期回调。本讲就是把这四个方法中的两个「求解器」方法彻底拆开。所有配置键的来源遵循 u1-l5 讲过的五层叠加规则：`get_cfg()` 默认值 → `add_deeplab_config` → `add_maskformer2_config` → yaml → 命令行。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [train_net.py](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L175-L262) | 本讲主战场：`build_lr_scheduler`（L175-181）、`build_optimizer`（L183-262），以及两个外部函数的 import（L45-46） |
| [mask2former/config.py](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/config.py#L22-L27) | `add_maskformer2_config` 注册的 solver 键默认值：`WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED`、`OPTIMIZER="ADAMW"`、`BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER=0.1` |
| [configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L19-L35) | COCO 系训练的实际 SOLVER 取值（BASE_LR、WEIGHT_DECAY、CLIP_GRADIENTS 等） |
| [configs/ade20k/panoptic-segmentation/Base-ADE20K-PanopticSegmentation.yaml](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/ade20k/panoptic-segmentation/Base-ADE20K-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L19-L35) | ADE20K 系显式启用 `WarmupPolyLR` 的范例 |
| [mask2former/modeling/backbone/swin.py](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/modeling/backbone/swin.py#L105-L108) | `relative_position_bias_table` / `absolute_pos_embed` 这两个「免衰减」参数的定义处 |
| [mask2former/modeling/transformer_decoder/mask2former_transformer_decoder.py](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/modeling/transformer_decoder/mask2former_transformer_decoder.py#L314-L322) | `query_feat` / `query_embed` / `level_embed` 三个 `nn.Embedding` 的定义处（命中 Embedding 衰减规则） |
| detectron2（外部依赖） | `detectron2.projects.deeplab.build_lr_scheduler` 与 `detectron2.solver.build.maybe_add_gradient_clipping`，由 [train_net.py:45-46](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L45-L46) 导入；其内部行号不在本仓库，标「待确认」处需在自己的 detectron2 安装目录里核对 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 build_optimizer：按模块名分组的参数组工厂

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`build_optimizer` 解决的问题是：**给模型里每一类参数挑合适的 lr 和 weight decay**。它一次遍历模型的所有参数，根据「参数所在模块的名字」和「参数所在模块的类型」套用四条规则，最终产出一个参数组列表交给 AdamW。

四条规则（按源码顺序，后命中者覆盖先命中者）：

| 规则 | 判断依据 | 效果 | 动机 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ① backbone 降 lr | 模块路径名包含 `"backbone"` | `lr *= BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER`（默认 0.1） | backbone 有 ImageNet 预训练，只需轻微微调 |
| ② 位置参数免衰减 | 参数名含 `relative_position_bias_table` 或 `absolute_pos_embed` | `weight_decay = 0` | 位置偏置是「坐标查表」性质的参数，衰减它等于系统性削弱位置信息（Swin 论文惯例） |
| ③ norm 层特殊衰减 | 模块是 `nn.LayerNorm` / `nn.GroupNorm` / 各种 BN / InstanceNorm | `weight_decay = WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM` | norm 层的仿射参数量少、作用关键，通常单独设 0 |
| ④ Embedding 特殊衰减 | 模块是 `nn.Embedding` | `weight_decay = WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED`（默认 0） | query/level 嵌入表与位置编码同理，不衰减 |

还有两个前置过滤：`requires_grad=False` 的参数直接跳过（冻结参数不进优化器）；用 `memo` 集合去重，避免同一个参数（如共享权重）因出现在多个模块路径下被重复加入。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
build_optimizer(cfg, model):
    defaults = {lr: BASE_LR, weight_decay: WEIGHT_DECAY}
    params, memo = [], set()
    for (module_name, module) in model.named_modules():        # 逐模块
        for (param_name, value) in module.named_parameters(recurse=False):  # 只看直属参数
            if not value.requires_grad:  continue              # 过滤冻结参数
            if value in memo:           continue               # 去重（共享参数）
            memo.add(value)
            h = copy(defaults)
            if "backbone" in module_name:                      # 规则①
                h.lr = h.lr * BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER
            if "relative_position_bias_table" in param_name \
               or "absolute_pos_embed" in param_name:          # 规则②
                h.weight_decay = 0.0
            if isinstance(module, NORM_TYPES): h.weight_decay = WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM   # 规则③
            if isinstance(module, nn.Embedding): h.weight_decay = WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED # 规则④
            params.append({"params": [value], **h})            # 每个参数一组
    optimizer = (带裁剪包装的 AdamW)(params, BASE_LR)
    return optimizer
```

注意三个细节：

1. **遍历的是模块，判断的是两种名字**：`module_name` 是模块路径（如 `backbone.res2`、`sem_seg_head.pixel_decoder...`），规则①按它做子串匹配；`module_param_name` 是参数在模块内的属性名（如 `weight`、`relative_position_bias_table`），规则②按它匹配。
2. **规则可叠加**：一个参数可以同时命中①和③——比如 Swin backbone 里某个 LayerNorm 的 weight，lr 会被乘 0.1，weight_decay 会被换成 `WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM`。规则②在规则③之前执行，所以如果某个位置参数恰好长在 norm 模块上，norm 的衰减会覆盖「免衰减」——实际不会发生，因为 `relative_position_bias_table` 是 `nn.Parameter` 直接挂在 block 上（见 4.1.3）。
3. **每组只有一个参数**：`{"params": [value], ...}`，因此一个 4700 万参数的 R50 模型会产生数千个 param group。对 AdamW 来说每组独立维护状态，功能等价，只是构建开销略大。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**入口与默认值**（[train_net.py:183-190](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L183-L190)）：先取两个特殊衰减系数，再定基底超参——所有参数默认用 `SOLVER.BASE_LR` 与 `SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY`，后面按规则逐个改写。

**norm 模块类型表**（[train_net.py:192-204](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L192-L204)）：一个元组列出了所有被视为「norm 层」的 PyTorch 模块类型。注意 `NaiveSyncBatchNorm` 继承自 `BatchNorm2d`，所以无需单独列出。Mask2Former 中真正会命中这个表的是：Transformer 解码器里的 `nn.LayerNorm`（含自注意力/FFN/decoder_norm）以及 `maskformer2_R50_bs16_50ep.yaml` 中 `NORM: "GN"` 指定的 GroupNorm（见 [maskformer2_R50_bs16_50ep.yaml:12](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/maskformer2_R50_bs16_50ep.yaml#L12)，它作用于 sem_seg_head/pixel decoder）。

**遍历与四条规则**（[train_net.py:206-230](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L206-L230)）：

- L208-215：双层遍历 + 两个过滤（`requires_grad` 检查、`memo` 去重）。
- L217：`hyperparams = copy.copy(defaults)`——每个参数拿到一份默认值副本，互不干扰。
- [L218-219](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L218-L219)：规则①，backbone 学习率乘 `cfg.SOLVER.BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER`。
- [L220-225](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L220-L225)：规则②，参数名含 `relative_position_bias_table` 或 `absolute_pos_embed` 时 `weight_decay=0.0`。注意 L224 有一行裸 `print(module_param_name)`——这是作者留下的调试输出，训练 Mask2Former 时终端会先刷出一串 `relative_position_bias_table`，很多人第一次都会疑惑它的来源，就是这里。
- [L226-229](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L226-L229)：规则③④，按模块类型替换 weight_decay。
- L230：`params.append({"params": [value], **hyperparams})` 收尾。

**规则②命中的参数长什么样？** 它们只在 Swin backbone 里存在：`relative_position_bias_table` 是每个 SwinTransformerBlock 上的一个直接 `nn.Parameter`（[swin.py:105-108](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/modeling/backbone/swin.py#L105-L108)，形状 `(2W_h-1)(2W_w-1) × nH`，是窗口注意力的相对位置偏置查表）；`absolute_pos_embed` 只在 `APE=True` 时存在（[swin.py:575-578](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/modeling/backbone/swin.py#L575-L578)，而默认 `APE: False`，见 [config.py:87](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/config.py#L87) 与 [swin_tiny_bs16_50ep.yaml:10](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/swin/maskformer2_swin_tiny_bs16_50ep.yaml#L10)）。因为它是 `nn.Parameter` 属性而非子模块，规则④的 `isinstance(module, nn.Embedding)` 抓不到它，必须靠规则②的**名字匹配**——这就是两条规则并存的原因。

**规则④命中的参数**：Transformer 解码器里的三个嵌入表——`query_feat`（可学习 query 特征）、`query_embed`（可学习 query 位置编码）、`level_embed`（尺度嵌入），见 [mask2former_transformer_decoder.py:314-322](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/modeling/transformer_decoder/mask2former_transformer_decoder.py#L314-L322)。它们的衰减系数是 `SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED`，由 [config.py:22-27](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/config.py#L22-L27) 注册，默认 `0.0`——与位置参数免衰减的动机一致：这些都是「坐标/身份查表」，不该被衰减拉向 0。

**配置侧的实际取值**（[Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml:19-35](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L19-L35)）：`BASE_LR: 0.0001`、`WEIGHT_DECAY: 0.05`、`OPTIMIZER: "ADAMW"`、`BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER: 0.1`。对照 [config.py:24-27](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/config.py#L24-L27)（`add_maskformer2_config` 的 solver 段）可以看到：yaml 里的这三项与注册默认值相同，写出来是为了显式声明。`WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM` 不是 Mask2Former 注册的键，而是 detectron2 `get_cfg()` 自带的默认键，仓库所有 yaml 都没有覆盖它，实际取值以本地安装的 detectron2 默认为准（实践里打印确认；detectron2 默认为 0.0，待本地验证）。

   ```python
   # optimizer_groups_report.py（示例代码）
   import argparse, copy
   from collections import Counter
   from typing import Any, Dict, List, Set
   import torch
   from detectron2.config import get_cfg
   from detectron2.modeling import build_model
   from detectron2.projects.deeplab import add_deeplab_config
   import mask2former  # noqa: F401  import 即注册 MaskFormer 等
   from mask2former import add_maskformer2_config


   def build_param_groups(cfg, model):
       """逐行对应 train_net.py Trainer.build_optimizer 的分组逻辑。"""
       weight_decay_norm = cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM
       weight_decay_embed = cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED
       defaults = {"lr": cfg.SOLVER.BASE_LR, "weight_decay": cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY}

       norm_module_types = (
           torch.nn.BatchNorm1d, torch.nn.BatchNorm2d, torch.nn.BatchNorm3d,
           torch.nn.SyncBatchNorm, torch.nn.GroupNorm,
           torch.nn.InstanceNorm1d, torch.nn.InstanceNorm2d, torch.nn.InstanceNorm3d,
           torch.nn.LayerNorm, torch.nn.LocalResponseNorm,
       )

       params: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
       memo: Set[torch.nn.parameter.Parameter] = set()
       n_skipped = 0
       for module_name, module in model.named_modules():
           for module_param_name, value in module.named_parameters(recurse=False):
               if not value.requires_grad:
                   n_skipped += 1
                   continue
               if value in memo:
                   continue
               memo.add(value)
               h = copy.copy(defaults)
               if "backbone" in module_name:
                   h["lr"] = h["lr"] * cfg.SOLVER.BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER
               if "relative_position_bias_table" in module_param_name \
                       or "absolute_pos_embed" in module_param_name:
                   h["weight_decay"] = 0.0
               if isinstance(module, norm_module_types):
                   h["weight_decay"] = weight_decay_norm
               if isinstance(module, torch.nn.Embedding):
                   h["weight_decay"] = weight_decay_embed
               params.append({"params": [value], "name": f"{module_name}.{module_param_name}", **h})
       return params, n_skipped


   def report(cfg_path):
       cfg = get_cfg()
       add_deeplab_config(cfg)
       add_maskformer2_config(cfg)
       cfg.merge_from_file(cfg_path)
       cfg.MODEL.DEVICE = "cpu"
       cfg.freeze()
       model = build_model(cfg)
       groups, n_skipped = build_param_groups(cfg, model)

       print(f"config = {cfg_path}")
       print(f"BASE_LR={cfg.SOLVER.BASE_LR} BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER={cfg.SOLVER.BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER} "
             f"WEIGHT_DECAY={cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY} WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM={cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM} "
             f"WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED={cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED}")
       print(f"requires_grad=False 被跳过的参数个数: {n_skipped}")

       # 按 (lr, weight_decay) 统计每组参数量
       stat = Counter()
       for g in groups:
           stat[(g["lr"], g["weight_decay"])] += g["params"][0].numel()
       for (lr, wd), numel in sorted(stat.items()):
           print(f"lr={lr:.2e}  weight_decay={wd}  参数量={numel/1e6:.2f}M")

       # 抽样打印规则命中的代表
       for key in ("relative_position_bias_table", "absolute_pos_embed"):
           hits = [g for g in groups if key in g["name"]]
           print(f"规则②命中 {key}: {len(hits)} 个, 示例 wd={hits[0]['weight_decay'] if hits else 'N/A'}")
       for g in groups:
           if isinstance(g["params"][0], torch.nn.Parameter) and "decoder_norm" in g["name"]:
               print(f"规则③示例: {g['name']}  wd={g['weight_decay']}")
               break
       emb = [g for g in groups if "query_embed" in g["name"] or "level_embed" in g["name"]]
       if emb:
           print(f"规则④示例: {emb[0]['name']}  wd={emb[0]['weight_decay']}")


   if __name__ == "__main__":
       parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
       parser.add_argument("--config-file", required=True)
       report(parser.parse_args().config_file)
   ```

### 4.2 maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping：动态子类化实现全局梯度裁剪

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

梯度裁剪有两种粒度：

- **逐参数裁剪**（detectron2 原生 `maybe_add_gradient_clipping` 支持）：每个参数单独算范数单独缩放。优点是可与 per-parameter clip value 精细配合，缺点是「整体方向感」差——一个参数的超大梯度不会牵动其他参数一起缩。
- **全模型裁剪**（full model clipping）：把所有参数的梯度拼在一起算一个全局 L2 范数，超过阈值整体缩放。DETR 系 Transformer 训练的标准做法是这一种。

[train_net.py:233](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L232-L233) 的注释直说了动机："detectron2 doesn't have full model gradient clipping now"。所以 Mask2Former 自己实现了一个，并且实现方式很巧：**不改训练循环，而是动态生成一个优化器子类，重写 `step()`**。

另一个背景是 AMP：Base 配置都开了混合精度（`AMP.ENABLED: True`，[Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml:34-35](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L34-L35)），fp16 数值范围小，梯度更容易溢出，全局裁剪 + 梯度缩放是标配组合。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping(optim_class):
    if CLIP_GRADIENTS.ENABLED
       and CLIP_TYPE == "full_model"
       and CLIP_VALUE > 0:
        class FullModelGradientClippingOptimizer(optim_class):   # 动态子类化
            def step(closure=None):
                all_params = chain(所有 param_groups 的所有参数)
                clip_grad_norm_(all_params, CLIP_VALUE)   # 先全局裁剪
                super().step(closure)                     # 再正常更新
        return FullModelGradientClippingOptimizer
    else:
        return optim_class    # 原样返回，不加包装
```

调用侧的写法是 `maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping(torch.optim.AdamW)(params, BASE_LR)`——传入的是**类**（不是实例），返回的也是类，随后立刻实例化。这是一个「类装饰器」。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**包装函数本体**（[train_net.py:232-247](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L232-L247)）：

- L234-239：三个条件同时满足才启用——`CLIP_GRADIENTS.ENABLED`、`CLIP_TYPE == "full_model"`、`CLIP_VALUE > 0.0`。任何一个不满足就原样返回优化器类。
- L241-245：在函数体内 `class FullModelGradientClippingOptimizer(optim)` 定义子类——Python 允许在函数里定义类，且基类可以是运行时传入的变量，于是同一个包装函数对 SGD 和 AdamW 都适用。`step()` 先用 `itertools.chain` 把所有 param group 的参数扁平化（这正是 4.1 里「每组一个参数」的结构在这里的代价与便利：chain 拼接即可），交给 `torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_` 做全局 L2 裁剪，再调用 `super().step()` 执行真正的 AdamW 更新。
- L247：启用则返回子类，否则返回原类。

**调用点与优化器分发**（[train_net.py:249-262](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L249-L262)）：

- L250-253：`OPTIMIZER == "SGD"` 分支（带 momentum），仓库配置不用它，但保留了对 detectron2 旧项目的兼容。
- L254-257：`OPTIMIZER == "ADAMW"` 分支——所有 Base yaml 都写 `OPTIMIZER: "ADAMW"`，这是实际走的路径：`maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping(torch.optim.AdamW)(params, cfg.SOLVER.BASE_LR)`。
- L258-259：其它名字直接抛 `NotImplementedError`。
- [L260-261](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L260-L261)：若 `CLIP_TYPE` **不是** `full_model`，则退回 detectron2 原生的 `maybe_add_gradient_clipping`（从 [train_net.py:46](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L45-L46) 导入，实现位于 detectron2 的 `solver/build.py`，外部依赖，行号待确认）。注意仓库内所有 Base yaml 的裁剪配置都是同一套（`ENABLED: True` / `CLIP_TYPE: "full_model"` / `CLIP_VALUE: 0.01` / `NORM_TYPE: 2.0`，如 [Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml:29-33](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L29-L33)，可用 grep 验证），所以 L260-261 这条回退路径在实际配置下从不执行，只是兼容出口。

一个值得注意的小细节：配置里有 `NORM_TYPE: 2.0`，但本仓库的 `step()` 直接调用 `clip_grad_norm_`（固定 L2 范数），并没有读这个键——`NORM_TYPE` 只对 detectron2 原生裁剪路径有意义。

**为什么「包装类」比「改训练循环」好？** 因为 detectron2 的 `DefaultTrainer` 拿到优化器后会在每个 iteration 结束时自动调 `optimizer.step()`。只要 `step()` 本身带上了裁剪逻辑，训练循环一行都不用改——这是插件式项目「不侵入宿主框架」的典型手法（呼应 u1-l3 的架构主题）。

**实践目标**：亲眼看到「全局裁剪」生效——构造一个梯度范数远超阈值的参数，验证 step 前后梯度被缩放、参数更新量被限制。

   ```python
   import itertools
   import torch

   CLIP_VALUE = 0.01  # 与 Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml 相同

   class FullModelGradientClippingAdamW(torch.optim.AdamW):
       def step(self, closure=None):
           all_params = itertools.chain(*[x["params"] for x in self.param_groups])
           torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(all_params, CLIP_VALUE)
           super().step(closure=closure)

   w = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor([1000.0]))   # 梯度将远超阈值
   opt = FullModelGradientClippingAdamW([w], lr=0.1)

   w.grad = torch.tensor([100.0])
   grad_norm_before = w.grad.norm().item()
   opt.step()                                       # step 内部先裁剪再更新
   print(f"裁剪前梯度范数: {grad_norm_before:.4f}")  # 100.0
   print(f"裁剪后参数值:  {w.item():.6f}")            # 期望 ≈ 999.9 量级
   ```

**练习 1**：为什么 `FullModelGradientClippingOptimizer` 要定义成 `maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping` 的内嵌类，而不是模块级的固定类？

### 4.3 build_lr_scheduler 与 poly 学习率调度

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`build_lr_scheduler` 决定学习率如何随 iteration 变化。Mask2Former 没有自己写调度器，而是直接复用 detectron2 **DeepLab 工程**的构建函数（[train_net.py:45](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L45) 导入的 `detectron2.projects.deeplab.build_lr_scheduler`），原因是它提供了 `WarmupPolyLR`——把 warmup 与 poly 衰减拼接的调度器：

\[
\text{lr}(t) = \text{lr}_0 \cdot \underbrace{\min\left(1,\; \frac{t}{T_w} \cdot \frac{1}{f_w}\right)}_{\text{warmup 因子（前 } T_w \text{ 步）}} \cdot \underbrace{\left(1 - \frac{t}{T}\right)^{\gamma}}_{\text{poly 因子}}, \qquad \gamma \approx 0.9
\]

其中 \( T_w \) 是 `SOLVER.WARMUP_ITERS`、\( f_w \) 与 `SOLVER.WARMUP_FACTOR` 相关、\( T \) 是 `SOLVER.MAX_ITER`。公式给出的是 poly 调度的标准形态；detectron2 deeplab 工程里的具体实现（含幂指数默认值、warmup 拼接细节）位于 `detectron2/projects/deeplab/build_solver.py`，属外部依赖，行号与精确默认值待本地确认（本仓库 yaml 未覆盖幂指数键）。

仓库内两类 Base 配置给出了两种组合方式：

| 配置族 | 调度器 | 关键键 | 行为 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ADE20K / Cityscapes / Mapillary 系 | 显式 `LR_SCHEDULER_NAME: "WarmupPolyLR"`（如 [Base-ADE20K...yaml:27](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/ade20k/panoptic-segmentation/Base-ADE20K-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L19-L35)） | `MAX_ITER: 160000`、`WARMUP_ITERS: 0`、无 `STEPS` | 纯 poly：从 1e-4 平滑衰减到 0 |
| COCO 系 | yaml 未写调度器名 | `STEPS: (327778, 355092)`、`MAX_ITER: 368750`、`WARMUP_ITERS: 10`、`WARMUP_FACTOR: 1.0`（[Base-COCO...yaml:19-35](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L19-L35)） | 调度器名取 detectron2 默认键（实践第 1 步打印确认），`STEPS` 表明按 multi-step 阶梯衰减设计 |

注意 COCO 的 `WARMUP_FACTOR: 1.0` + `WARMUP_ITERS: 10` 实际上让 warmup 近似形同虚设（初始因子就是 1）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
Trainer.build_lr_scheduler(cfg, optimizer):
    return detectron2.projects.deeplab.build_lr_scheduler(cfg, optimizer)
        ├─ 若 SOLVER.LR_SCHEDULER_NAME == "WarmupPolyLR":
        │      构造 warmup + poly 衰减调度器（实现于 deeplab 工程）
        └─ 否则: 回退 detectron2 原生 build_lr_scheduler
                 （支持 WarmupMultiStepLR 等，由 STEPS/MAX_ITER 驱动）
```

调度器与优化器的关系：调度器并不「拥有」学习率，它在每个 iteration 末尾（`scheduler.step()`）改写优化器各 param_group 的 `lr` 字段。与 4.1 联动后，backbone 组的 lr 恒为其它组的 0.1 倍——poly 因子对所有组同乘。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**Trainer 的覆写**（[train_net.py:175-181](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L175-L181)）：只是把 detectron2 默认实现替换为 deeplab 版本——docstring 写明 "It now calls detectron2.solver.build_lr_scheduler. Overwrite it if you'd like a different scheduler"（实际上调的是 deeplab 的同名函数，它内部再决定是否回退原生实现）。这个覆写是 `WarmupPolyLR` 能被识别的唯一前提。

**为什么 import 的是 deeplab？** [train_net.py:285-287](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L281-L288) 的 `setup()` 里有一行注释 "# for poly lr schedule"——`add_deeplab_config(cfg)` 除注册语义分割相关键外，还带来 poly 调度所需的支持；`build_lr_scheduler` 与之配套。两个 import 都来自 `detectron2.projects.deeplab`（[train_net.py:45](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L45)），这是一条「把别的工程的求解器借来用」的依赖线。

**配置证据**：

- ADE20K Base 的 SOLVER 段（[Base-ADE20K-PanopticSegmentation.yaml:19-35](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/ade20k/panoptic-segmentation/Base-ADE20K-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L19-L35)）：`LR_SCHEDULER_NAME: "WarmupPolyLR"` + `MAX_ITER: 160000`，没有 `STEPS`——典型的「按迭代总数的 poly 衰减」配方。
- COCO Base 的 SOLVER 段（[Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml:19-35](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/Base-COCO-PanopticSegmentation.yaml#L19-L35)）：给了 `STEPS: (327778, 355092)`（约在 89%、96% 进度处降 lr）与 `MAX_ITER: 368750`（50ep），没有写调度器名——所以 COCO 配置实际用哪个调度器取决于合并后 `cfg.SOLVER.LR_SCHEDULER_NAME` 的值（detectron2 默认键，实践第 1 步验证）。

**与优化器的组装顺序**（回顾 u2-l1）：detectron2 引擎先 `build_optimizer`（参数分组 + 裁剪包装），再 `build_lr_scheduler(cfg, optimizer)`（拿到优化器引用以便改写各组 lr）。二者都只在 Trainer 构造期调用一次。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：确认两个配置族实际使用的学习率调度器类型，并画出 ADE20K 的 poly 学习率曲线。

**操作步骤**：

1. 写脚本 `lr_curve.py`（示例代码）：

   ```python
   # lr_curve.py（示例代码）
   import argparse
   import torch
   from detectron2.config import get_cfg
   from detectron2.projects.deeplab import add_deeplab_config, build_lr_scheduler
   import mask2former  # noqa: F401
   from mask2former import add_maskformer2_config

   parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   parser.add_argument("--config-file", required=True)
   args = parser.parse_args()

   cfg = get_cfg()
   add_deeplab_config(cfg)
   add_maskformer2_config(cfg)
   cfg.merge_from_file(args.config_file)
   cfg.freeze()
   print(f"LR_SCHEDULER_NAME = {cfg.SOLVER.LR_SCHEDULER_NAME}")
   print(f"BASE_LR={cfg.SOLVER.BASE_LR}  MAX_ITER={cfg.SOLVER.MAX_ITER}  "
         f"STEPS={cfg.SOLVER.STEPS}  WARMUP_ITERS={cfg.SOLVER.WARMUP_ITERS}")

   w = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1))
   optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW([w], lr=cfg.SOLVER.BASE_LR)
   scheduler = build_lr_scheduler(cfg, optimizer)

   pts = []
   step = max(1, cfg.SOLVER.MAX_ITER // 160)   # 采样 ~160 个点
   for it in range(cfg.SOLVER.MAX_ITER):
       if it % step == 0:
           pts.append((it, optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]))
       optimizer.step()
       scheduler.step()
   for it, lr in pts[::4]:
       print(f"iter {it:>7d}   lr {lr:.3e}")
   ```

2. 跑 ADE20K 与 COCO 各一次：

   ```bash
   python lr_curve.py --config-file configs/ade20k/panoptic-segmentation/maskformer2_R50_bs16_160k.yaml
   python lr_curve.py --config-file configs/coco/panoptic-segmentation/maskformer2_R50_bs16_50ep.yaml
   ```

**需要观察的现象**：两个配置打印出的 `LR_SCHEDULER_NAME`；ADE20K 的 lr 序列是否从 1e-4 单调平滑衰减到接近 0；COCO 的 lr 序列是否在 `STEPS` 附近出现阶梯（若是 multi-step）或平滑曲线（若也是 poly）。

**预期结果**（待本地验证）：

- ADE20K：`WarmupPolyLR`，曲线满足 \(\text{lr}(t) = 10^{-4}(1 - t/160000)^{\gamma}\)——在 t=80k 处约为初始值的一半附近（\(0.5^{0.9}\approx0.54\)）。
- COCO：调度器名与曲线形态由 detectron2 默认值决定；若为 multi-step，则在前 89% 迭代保持 1e-4，在 327778 和 355092 处两次下跳。把两种曲线画在同一张图上，即可直观对比「poly vs 阶梯」两种衰减哲学。

若本地无法完整跑 16 万步循环，可把循环上限改成 `cfg.SOLVER.MAX_ITER // 100` 并同步把 `MAX_ITER` 缩小 100 倍后再构建调度器，观察曲线形状即可。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 ADE20K 配置不需要 `STEPS`，而 COCO 配置需要？

答案：poly 调度只需要总迭代数 `MAX_ITER`，学习率按公式连续衰减，没有「阶梯时刻」；multi-step 调度则必须显式给出每次降 lr 的迭代位置 `STEPS`。两族配置的 SOLVER 段差异直接反映了所用调度器的参数需求。

**练习 2**：`build_lr_scheduler(cfg, optimizer)` 为什么要传 optimizer？

答案：PyTorch 的学习率调度器通过修改优化器 `param_groups` 里各组的 `lr` 生效，构造时必须持有优化器引用；这也解释了 4.1 中分组设置的初始 lr 会被调度器随时间统一改写（各组按相同因子缩放，backbone 组始终保持 0.1 倍关系）。

**练习 3**：COCO Base 里 `WARMUP_FACTOR: 1.0`、`WARMUP_ITERS: 10` 的组合意味着什么？

答案：warmup 阶段极短且初始因子已是 1.0，即学习率从第一步起就是 `BASE_LR`，warmup 基本不生效。这是 COCO 大数据集长训练下「不需要小心预热」的工程选择；对比 MaskFormer 一代/其它小数据配置会更依赖 warmup。

## 5. 综合实践

**任务：产出一份《Mask2Former R50/Swin-tiny 参数分组审计报告》。**

把 4.1.4 的脚本扩展成完整审计：

1. 对 R50 与 Swin-tiny 两个 COCO 配置各跑一次参数分组统计。
2. 报告须包含四张小表：
   - 表 A：`(lr, weight_decay)` 组合 → 参数量占比（两种 backbone 各一列）；
   - 表 B：规则②命中的参数清单（模块路径 + 形状 + wd）；
   - 表 C：规则③④命中的代表参数（`decoder_norm.weight`、`query_embed.weight`、`level_embed.weight`）与其 wd 来源键；
   - 表 D：`requires_grad=False` 被跳过的参数（验证 FrozenBN 结论）。
3. 用一句话回答：从 R50 换到 Swin-tiny，优化器层面（而非模型层面）唯一的行为差异是什么？
4. 再用 4.3.4 的脚本分别记录两个配置的 lr 曲线若干采样点，附在报告末尾，并解释「backbone 组的 lr 曲线与头部组保持什么数学关系」。

参考答案（第 3、4 问）：优化器层面的唯一差异是规则②开始生效——Swin 的每个窗口注意力 block 的 `relative_position_bias_table` 进入 `weight_decay=0` 的组（R50 无此参数）；lr 曲线上，backbone 组在任意时刻都是头部组的 `BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER=0.1` 倍，因为调度器对各组施加相同缩放因子，而分组时设置的初始 lr 比例被保留（具体数值待本地验证）。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `build_optimizer` 是一个「参数组工厂」：双层遍历所有模块的直属参数，按四条规则（backbone lr × 0.1、Swin 位置参数 wd=0、norm 层用 `WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM`、Embedding 用 `WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED`）为**每个参数单独**生成一组超参，再交给 AdamW（[train_net.py:183-230](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L183-L230)）。
- 规则②只在 Swin backbone 上命中：`relative_position_bias_table` 是裸 `nn.Parameter`，只能靠参数名匹配（[swin.py:105-108](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/mask2former/modeling/backbone/swin.py#L105-L108)）；R50 配置下该规则从不触发，源码里那行裸 `print`（L224）就是它的「显形」时刻。
- 全模型梯度裁剪通过「函数内动态定义优化器子类、重写 `step()`」实现，先对链式拼接的全部参数做 `clip_grad_norm_` 再更新，不侵入 detectron2 训练循环（[train_net.py:232-247](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Mask2Former/blob/9b0651c6c1d5b3af2e6da0589b719c514ec0d69a/train_net.py#L232-L247)）；仓库所有 Base 配置都用 `full_model` + `CLIP_VALUE=0.01`，detectron2 原生逐参数裁剪只是兼容回退分支。
- `build_lr_scheduler` 直接复用 detectron2 deeplab 工程的构建函数以获得 `WarmupPolyLR`（warmup + \( (1-t/T)^{0.9} \) 衰减）；ADE20K/Cityscapes/Mapillary 系显式启用 poly，COCO 系则配 `STEPS` 阶梯衰减（实际调度器名需打印合并后配置确认）。
- 学习率策略总结成一句话：**ADAMW（BASE_LR=1e-4，backbone ×0.1）+ 按任务选择的 poly/step 衰减 + 全模型 L2 梯度裁剪 0.01 + AMP**，这一整套来自分割与检测两条社区经验线的组合。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- 下一讲（u3-l1）进入模型本体：`MaskFormer.forward` 的训练/推理两条路径。你会看到本讲的 `weight_dict` 与损失 dict 如何在 meta arch 里汇合。
- 建议顺手阅读两个外部文件（在本地 detectron2 安装目录）：`detectron2/solver/build.py`（原生 `build_optimizer` 与 `maybe_add_gradient_clipping`，对比 Mask2Former 版改了什么）和 `detectron2/projects/deeplab/build_solver.py`（`WarmupPolyLR` 的真实实现），把本讲标注「待确认」的细节补全。
- 想深入 poly 调度的来历，可读 DeepLabv3 论文的 learning rate 一节；想深入 AdamW，可读 Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization（Loshchilov & Hutter, 2019）。

schema.name: Agent
schema.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

  }

    ))
  )
